scenarios.claim: An incremental backup chain is eligible only when its full base was created on 18.7 or later after the 18.7 update.
scenarios.evidence: PostgreSQL 18.7 release notes state existing incremental backup files should not be trusted and recommend a new full backup after updating.

scenarios.claim: A restart at the lsn_events_processed=1 offset boundary must not lose an already committed source change.
scenarios.evidence: DBZ-2889 is listed among PostgreSQL changes-lost-on-restart fixes in 3.7.1.Final.

scenarios.claim: A restart when the stored offset is at a transactional logical message must not omit subsequent committed row changes.
scenarios.evidence: DBZ-2889 covers offsets stored at transactional logical messages.

scenarios.claim: A BEGIN sharing a stored LSN must not cause a processed row to be emitted again or skipped incorrectly.
scenarios.evidence: DBZ-2894 identifies decoderbufs BEGIN/LSN skip behavior fixed in 3.7.1.Final.

scenarios.claim: Leader election must not cause size-based retention to delete data that remains within the local/remote retention policy.
scenarios.evidence: KAFKA-20732 is listed as a tiered-storage data-loss fix in 4.3.2.

scenarios.claim: A broker restart must not truncate the time index such that segments still inside retention are deleted.
scenarios.evidence: KAFKA-20979 is listed as a data-loss fix in 4.3.2.

scenarios.claim: Annotating a backup found in a non-default repository must not overwrite backup.info in the default repository.
scenarios.evidence: pgBackRest 2.60.1 fixes annotate writing backup.info to the default repository; upstream notes describe multi-repository behavior.

scenarios.claim: A block-incremental restore using SFTP storage must recover successfully across reconnect behavior.
scenarios.evidence: pgBackRest 2.60.1 fixes a possible block incremental restore failure on SFTP storage and SFTP handle use after reconnect.
